name: sponsor-tiers
title: Sponsor tiers
description: Sponsors or backers grouped by tier with falling visual weight, tier names as headings, an optional rel=sponsored and a clear way to join.
docs: Pass title, an optional description, tiers ({ name, size: 'lg' | 'md' | 'sm', sponsors: [{ name, mark?, avatar?, href?, blurb? }] }) and an optional action ({ label, href }). A lg tier shows large tiles with the mark, the name and a line; md a compact hairline grid of marks whose short last row grows to fill the width; sm supporters as avatars with names in columns (avatar is an image URL, initials stand in without one; the avatar is only decoration, so a link is read as the name alone). Tier names are h3 headings, a tier without sponsors is left out, each sponsor with an href is one link named by its text, and sponsoredLinks adds rel="sponsored" to every link when the sponsorship is paid. Works for open-source projects, events, charities and partner programmes.
